zh.title: 新客户端连接与本机密钥存储修复
items: 修复 macOS 端点击“连接新客户端”后立即失败的问题。
设备令牌、每客户端内容密钥和飞书密钥统一保存在应用数据目录的认证加密 vault 中。
Relayune 不再使用 macOS Keychain 保存应用秘密，并清理旧 Keychain 项。

en.title: New-client pairing and local secret storage fixes
items: Fixed the macOS flow that failed immediately after selecting Connect New Client.
Device tokens, per-client content keys, and Feishu keys now stay in an authenticated encrypted vault in the app data directory.
Relayune no longer stores application secrets in macOS Keychain and removes legacy Keychain entries.
